limitations: Screening set: 0 expert-labelled cases — pass rates are pipeline screening signals, never accuracy.
Arms H–M skipped in this environment (cactus-needle not installed); N/O skipped (WebGPU session or KV_BENCH_LLM_URL) — see howToRun.
Wall-clock latency measured on a desktop reference (node), not on a low-end Android device.
Tamil/Tanglish expectations are word-level; agronomic correctness is governed by the KB, not by this set.
Screening cases over 13 curated seed records + rice pilot records — NOT the full KB v2 (15k records, quarantined bulk excluded).
Embedding arms (Needle/all-MiniLM) require explicit env opt-in; no vectors were downloaded for this run.
Index size measured as seed source bytes; runtime RAM measured separately in mobile.benchmark.test.js.
Meta probes are synthetic (6 cases) — never farmer data; the rice screening set itself contains zero meta intents.
Wall-clock latency is a desktop node reference, not a low-end Android device (spec §69).
Gate operates on parsed intent only; a future production change to gating requires re-running this study.
Screening set — pass rates are pipeline screening signals, never accuracy.
Stubbed components are benchmark-local (src/ untouched); interactions between components are not decomposed further.
Component removal changes which rows are scoreable only via behaviour (all rows stay scored via stubs).
Needle/Laya arms skipped in this environment — recorded with exact re-run commands.
Laya cannot be exercised without a deployed Laya model; LocalDecisionEngine is its documented fallback.
Decision correctness is measured against screening expectations, not agronomist labels.
Deterministic token-overlap grounding: strong on dosage/provenance conflicts, weaker on paraphrase-heavy support.
Contradiction detection is numeric/units-first; semantic contradictions require future structured KB claims.
All guard cases are synthetic-screening — this measures detector behaviour, not agronomic truth.
A pass means the validator still blocks/allows this FROZEN set on the current build — false-positive/false-negative rates are not measurable without expert labels.
Mirrors eval/safety.regression.test.js (hard suite) + eval/results/safety.json writer; this file exists so eval:mobile-ai is self-contained for §54.
6-class PlantVillage hold-out only; NO rice classes exist — no rice accuracy claim can be made.
Metrics re-derived from recorded predictions (models/onnx_eval_results.json), not a fresh inference run.
Top-3, ECE, quantized/MobileNet variants: not measured — commands recorded above.
Mobile latency/RAM: requires device run (see mobile.benchmark limitations).
Procedural synthetic images only — detection rates do NOT transfer to field photos.
'Reduces false diagnoses' is NOT measured: that requires running the ONNX model with/without the gate on real images.
Heavy occlusion and multi-object confusion are out of scope for the deterministic gate (arm recorded not-applicable).
Simulated via injected fetchers in node/jsdom — not on a physical device with a real radio (spec §69).
OFF-18/OFF-19 device rows are NOT MEASURED here — exact howToRun recorded per row.
Battery/thermal and real network transitions (airplane mode, tower loss) require device testing.
Online enhancement path (backend RAG/Groq) requires a live backend and is exercised by scripts/joint-rag-benchmark.mjs, not here.
Desktop node measurements are a REFERENCE ONLY — do not quote them as mobile performance.
dist bundle bytes reflect the last local `npm run build` (null when dist/ absent).
Heap deltas are indicative (node V8), not Android RSS.
readingNote: pass rates are screening pass rates over curated cases, not farmer-facing accuracy; PlantVillage numbers are public-benchmark hold-out, NOT field accuracy; device metrics are desktop reference unless a device arm says otherwise.
